title: SSP-API-Normalizer Output
description: Normalized monetization data unified across SSP sources.

normalized_data.description: One entry per date row found in the raw payload.

date.description: Report date normalized to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Null if date could not be parsed.

ad_requests.description: Total ad requests (bid requests) sent to the SSP. 0 if not present in payload.

impressions.description: Total impressions served (wins/fills). 0 if not present in payload.

revenue_usd.description: Gross publisher revenue in USD. Calculated as (ecpm_usd / 1000) × impressions if not directly present.

ecpm_usd.description: Effective CPM in USD. Calculated as (revenue_usd / impressions) × 1000 if not directly present.

data_integrity_warnings.description: List of warnings about missing fields, reformatted dates, derived metrics, or data quality issues. Empty array if no issues detected.

data_integrity_warnings: ecpm_usd: calculated from revenue_usd and impressions
revenue_usd: calculated from ecpm_usd and impressions
